title: Developer spark tiles: API handshake motion asset set
creator: Sophie Li
description: Create a compact set of visual assets (static + motion) that illustrate the lightweight API handshake and streaming/tool-call flow for the API/SDK onboarding docs. Focus: small "spark" tiles that can be composed into docs hero banners, SDK README snippets, and the Console first-run panel. Assets should work as: (1) static 1200x600 hero PNG, (2) 3-frame GIF strip for step-by-step pages, (3) Lottie micro-interaction for landing page, (4) terminal-styled code overlay PNGs for SDK snippets. Visual language should be consistent with the developer design system: mono-type terminal, primary teal/red accents for success/error, and subtle motion that reduces on prefers-reduced-motion.
acceptance_criteria: Four unique tiles produced: handshake, token-exchange, streaming-response, tool-call-confirmation
Each tile exported as: PNG (1200x600), GIF (600x200 strip), and Lottie JSON where motion applies
All assets meet 4.5:1 text contrast and pass automated accessibility checks
Design tokens used from design-system v2.1 and assets reference token names
Final files uploaded to Drive + CDN and linked in docs PR; design reviewed and approved by PM and Eng
assets: tile-1_handshake_lottie.json (micro bounce on success, reduced for PRM)
tile-3_stream_response_static.png (shows streaming chunking + prefix cache icon)
tile-3_stream_response_strip.gif (illustrates first chunk, KV cache hit, steady state)
svg-sprite-set for micro-icons (kv-cache, kernel, region, fallback)
